agent_note: First-person narrator. Scene narration is consistently past ('I handed Bob over to Hal', 'we were parked half a block away'); the present-tense event quotes are standing description and narrating-moment reflection (the Burg, the narrator's mother, 'Now just a part of my history'), which is the ordinary present frame of a retrospective first-person voice rather than simultaneous narration. Thin yield: only 5 of 19 quotes are event-narration, split 2 past / 3 present, so the count alone is not decisive - the narrating_situation call rests on the scene-level past.
